## Project Background

Thermal camera images from IRES 2023 CACA project. Images were taken using a FLIR camera iPhone attachment. GitHub: https://github.com/joaofgoncalves/ThermalRaster #Load in packages

```{r}

library(ThermalRaster)
library(terra)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

```

#Image file load in

```{r}
# Image path in sample data
#image_path <- "/Users/isabeltorres/Desktop/ires/thermalcamera/20230725_ungr8fuldead_725pm.JPG"

# Provide here the folder path where the EXIFtool executale is
# NOTE: The executable must be named exiftool
 #"/opt/homebrew/bin/exiftool"

library(ThermalRaster)

image_path <- "/Users/isabeltorres/Desktop/ires/thermalcamera/20230725_ungr8fuldead_725pm.JPG"
exiftool_path <- dirname(Sys.which("exiftool"))
#Plot the FLIR image with RGB 
thumb <- flir_thumbnail_to_rast(image_path)

plotRGB(thumb)

#Check the full RGB 
# full RGB embedded in the FLIR JPEG
tmp_rgb <- file.path(tempdir(), "flir_rgb.jpg")

system2(
  Sys.which("exiftool"),
  args = c("-b", "-EmbeddedImage", shQuote(image_path)),
  stdout = tmp_rgb
)

rgb_hr <- terra::rast(tmp_rgb)
plotRGB(rgb_hr)

#checking the size of rgb to determine if we should zoom in on a specific area-basically read in the image without RGB to see the AOI clearly to help determine if we need to crop:
plotRGB(rgb_hr, main = "Full RGB (1440x1080")
#Read in the original image with thermal imagery:
plot_temp_rast(temp, palette = "magma")
#cropping the image using Terra for Mac 
#check dimensions and extents
dim(rgb_hr)
dim(temp)
ext(rgb_hr)
ext(temp)

#align RGB with and thermal image
rgb_match<- resample(rgb_hr, temp, method = "bilinear")

#verify your output 
dim(rgb_match)
dim(temp)

#crop the AOI
rgb_crop<- crop(rgb_hr, 
                ext(200, 880, 250, 1215))
plotRGB(rgb_crop)

#Exploring images side by side
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(2, 2, 3, 2))

plotRGB(rgb_match, main = "RGB")

plot_temp_rast(
  temp,
  palette = "magma",
  main = "Thermal (°C)"
)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

#Finding an ROI and extracting temperatures 
library(terra)

# view the thermal image
plot(temp)

# click around the understory area under one shrub
# press Esc when you are done
pts <- locator()

# close the polygon
xy <- cbind(pts$x, pts$y)
xy <- rbind(xy, xy[1, ])

# make a polygon ROI
roi <- vect(list(xy), type = "polygons", crs = crs(temp))

# pull out all temperature values in that ROI
vals <- extract(temp, roi)[,2]

# summary stats for that shrub understory
mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
median(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
range(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
```
